title: from ... to until since for
summary: Предлоги **from ... to**, **until / till**, **since** и **for**: начало, конец и длительность периода времени.
ru:
## from ... to — «с ... до»
Начало и конец периода.
> The shop is open **from** 9 **to** 6. — Магазин открыт с 9 до 6.
> We work **from** Monday **to** Friday. — Мы работаем с понедельника по пятницу.
Можно **from ... until / till**.

## until / till — «до»
**Until** (или **till**) показывает, до какого момента что-то продолжается.
> I'll wait **until** 6 o'clock. — Я подожду до шести.
> We stayed there **until** Sunday. — Мы остались там до воскресенья.
> Wait here **until** I come back. — Подожди здесь, пока я не вернусь.

## since и for — перфект
С present perfect (и present perfect continuous) употребляем **since** и **for**.

**since + момент в прошлом** — «с … (момента)»:
> I've lived here **since** 2019. — Я живу здесь с 2019 года.
> She's been ill **since** Monday. — Она больна с понедельника.
> It's been raining **since** morning. — Дождь идёт с утра.

**for + период** — «в течение, уже … (времени)»:
> I've lived here **for** five years. — Я живу здесь пять лет.
> She's been ill **for** three days. — Она болеет три дня.
> It's been raining **for** two hours. — Дождь идёт два часа.

## Как выбрать: since или for
| Вопрос | Слово | Примеры |
|---|---|---|
| **когда началось** (точка) | **since** | since 2019, since Monday, since 8 o'clock, since I was a child |
| **как долго** (период) | **for** | for five years, for three days, for two hours, for a long time |

## for без present perfect
**for** также употребляется с прошедшим и будущим.
> We stayed there **for** a week. — Мы пробыли там неделю.
> I'll be away **for** two days. — Меня не будет два дня.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I live here since 2019.~~ → I **have lived** here since 2019. (present perfect)
- ~~I've lived here since five years.~~ → I've lived here **for** five years.
- ~~I've been here for Monday.~~ → I've been here **since** Monday.
- ~~from Monday for Friday~~ → from Monday **to** Friday.
en:
## from ... to
The start and the end of a period.
> The shop is open **from** 9 **to** 6.
> We work **from** Monday **to** Friday.
You can also say **from ... until / till**.

## until / till
**Until** (or **till**) shows the time when something stops.
> I'll wait **until** 6 o'clock.
> We stayed there **until** Sunday.
> Wait here **until** I come back.

## since and for
We use **since** and **for** with the present perfect (and present perfect continuous).

**since + a point in time** — when it started:
> I've lived here **since** 2019.
> She's been ill **since** Monday.
> It's been raining **since** morning.

**for + a period of time** — how long:
> I've lived here **for** five years.
> She's been ill **for** three days.
> It's been raining **for** two hours.

## How to choose
| Question | Word | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| **when did it start?** | **since** | since 2019, since Monday, since 8 o'clock |
| **how long?** | **for** | for five years, for three days, for two hours |

## for in other tenses
> We stayed there **for** a week.
> I'll be away **for** two days.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I live here since 2019.~~ → I **have lived** here since 2019.
- ~~I've lived here since five years.~~ → I've lived here **for** five years.
- ~~I've been here for Monday.~~ → I've been here **since** Monday.
structure:
## from / to / until
| Конструкция | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **from ... to ...** | с ... до ... | from 9 to 5 |
| **from ... until ...** | с ... до ... | from Monday until Friday |
| **until / till** | до | until 6 o'clock |

## since / for
| Слово | Что после | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **since** | точка во времени | I've known her **since** 2015. |
| **for** | период времени | I've known her **for** ten years. |

## Формула с perfect
> have / has + V3 + **since** + момент
> have / has + V3 + **for** + период

## Сравните
| since | for |
|---|---|
| since **Monday** | for **three days** |
| since **2020** | for **four years** |
| since **7 o'clock** | for **two hours** |
| since **I was a child** | for **a long time** |
